critical_code_review_comments: [VERIFIED CLEAN] _decode_access_token (server.py:133-142) — both ExpiredSignatureError and InvalidTokenError chains use `raise … from e`; payload guarded by 'access' type check before return. No undefined-variable risk; lint was a false positive.

[VERIFIED CLEAN] sales_report (server.py:927-942) — `invs` iterator + scalar accumulators (`by_mode` dict, `total_revenue` float) — the outer-loop variable `inv` is no longer shadowed by a generator-expression inside `sum(...)`. Math (sum(by_mode.amount)) matches total_revenue within ±1.0.

[VERIFIED CLEAN] PublicBookingIn._when (server.py:1005-1020) — `except Exception as e: raise ValueError(...) from e` correctly attributes the cause; subsequent past-time & business-hours checks unchanged.

[VERIFIED CLEAN] dashboard() (server.py:903-924) — 6 local variables (today, month_prefix, invoices_today, invoices_month, appts_today, low_stock, review_stats — plus dict-unpacked via **). Three async helpers + one async helper call extracted cleanly. No code path changed; only structure. Response shape verified key-by-key.

[NICE-TO-HAVE — non-blocking] In _dashboard_review_stats (server.py:884-889) `pending_reviews = appointments(status=completed).count - len(all_reviews)` over-counts when a single appointment has multiple reviews (or under-counts when a review exists without an appointment). Not a regression — pre-existed before iter11. Leaving as nice-to-have.
